annotations.title: Who in my network knows someone there

description: Which of the signed-in user's OWN LinkedIn connections work at a company, for a warm introduction instead of a cold email. Reads only the connections this user uploaded to Fundz (app.fundz.net/my-network); never anyone else's network. Free, costs no reveal. Takes the company id or slug from a search result. get_company_contacts also shows this and flags contacts you are already connected to.

company.description: Company id or slug, e.g. "overfuel" or "181403" (search results include this)
